subject: Re: AitW status: per-subset baselines, instruction-source skew
body:
Fumiko, Santiago,

Decisions before the May 11 readout:

1. Headline metric is stratified by instruction source, always. The aggregate number goes in an appendix. If we normalize on the model-written phrasing we'll ship something that works in demos and fails for users.
2. WebShopping gets a dedicated action-head workstream in Q3; it's the biggest single gap and it maps to a real customer flow.
3. The resolution-robustness study stays in scope but reports v10-13 pooled rather than per-version — per-version splits are too thin to be meaningful.

Fumiko, send the stratified table Friday. Thanks — this was a genuinely clarifying quarter.

Priya
